prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview & Customize Your Companion", "See your pet live in the rendering stage before finalizing adoption details.", "Render Verified"]
1: ["Instant One-Click Account Link", "Enter your email to receive a seamless sign-in link that locks your pet profile to your account safely.", "Send Magic Link", "Auto-Sync Enabled"]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try feeding, calling, and hiding your pet right now before exiting setup.", "Enter Practice Sandbox"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "We are optimizing your pet's desktop rendering environment. Please confirm overlay permissions.", "Desktop Overlay Active", "System Tray Icon Docked"]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Select whether to adopt a pre-trained companion or generate a custom friend from your photos."]
5: ["Pick Your Adoption Journey", "Swipe to compare quick preset adoption with full custom photo creation."]
6: ["Your pet is being rendered in high definition. We'll play a gentle chime when ready!"]
7: ["Select a companion trait profile. Pets respond dynamically to your daily mouse and keyboard activity.", "High Desktop Reactivity", "Low Memory Usage"]
8: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Signing in links your pet safely to your cloud account so your pet state is never lost or reset when switching devices.", "Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account email to restore it instantly."]
9: ["Shortcut: Right-click your pet on desktop or click the tray icon anytime to open pet settings, hide, or talk!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information (email address).
